name: wts-missing-map-name
description: flat.w3x without war3map.wts (make-melee-valid.mjs nowts), Scenario > Map Description's Name typed over (Renamed Map) and OK (branch we-batch-3; Studio follows since branch fix/wts-missing-we: set_map_text, map-info/textedit.ts). The editor's save writes a war3map.wts of its own: strings 1 to 4 the name, suggested players, description and author, which the w3i names as TRIGSTR_001 to _004; the player and force names (TRIGSTR_001, _002 without a string) become "". The dialog's OK also sets the loading screen's crestRace 64 to 128, gameDataSet -1 to 0 and the three camera zooms 0 to 1250. It counts a save more (saves 1 to 2), which Studio never counts: left out

name: wts-present-map-name
description: The same on flat.w3x with its war3map.wts (make-melee-valid.mjs plain; strings 1 and 2 the player's and the force's names): the map's four texts become strings 3 to 6, appended to the table; the names keep their strings; crestRace, gameDataSet and the zooms as without a table (branch fix/wts-missing-we). saves left out as above
